HERACROSS,1.Pokedex: A tremendous influx of energy builds it up, but when Mega Evolution ends, Heracross is bothered by terrible soreness in its muscles.

CORSOLA,1.Pokedex: Sudden climate change wiped out this ancient kind of Corsola. This Pokémon absorbs others' life-force through its branches.

HOUNDOOM,1.Pokedex: Its red claws and the tips of its tail are melting from high internal temperatures that are painful to Houndoom itself.

TYRANITAR,1.Pokedex: Due to the colossal power poured into it, this Pokémon's back split right open. Its destructive instincts are the only thing keeping it moving.

ZIGZAGOON,1.Pokedex: Its restlessness has it constantly running around. If it sees another Pokémon, it will purposely run into them in order to start a fight.

LINOONE,1.Pokedex: It uses its long tongue to taunt opponents. Once the opposition is enraged, this Pokémon hurls itself at the opponent, tackling them forcefully.

SABLEYE,1.Pokedex: Supporting a giant heavy jewel, it can't change direction very nimbly and is vulnerable to attack from behind.

MAWILE,1.Pokedex: Its two sets of jaws thrash about violently as if they each had a will of their own. One gnash from them can turn a boulder to dust.

MANECTRIC,1.Pokedex: Too much electricity has built up in its body, irritating Manectric. Its explosive speed is equal to that of a lightning bolt.

SHARPEDO,1.Pokedex: The yellow patterns it bears are old scars. The energy from Mega Evolution runs through them, causing it sharp pain and suffering.

CASTFORM,1.Pokedex: This is the form Castform takes on the brightest of days. Its skin is unexpectedly hot to the touch, so approach with care.

CASTFORM,2.Pokedex: This is the form Castform takes when soaked with rain. When its body is compressed, water will seep out as if from a sponge.

CASTFORM,3.Pokedex: This is the form Castform takes when covered in snow. Its body becomes an ice-like material, with a temperature near -5 degrees Celsius.

BANETTE,1.Pokedex: Extraordinary energy amplifies its cursing power to such an extent that it can't help but curse its own Trainer.

ABSOL,1.Pokedex: When this Pokémon whips the winglike fur on its back as though beating its wings, it sends an intimidating aura flying at its opponents.

GLALIE,1.Pokedex: It envelops prey in its mouth, freezing them instantly. But its jaw is dislocated, so it's unable to eat them.

SALAMENCE,1.Pokedex: It puts its forelegs inside its shell to streamline itself for flight. Salamence flies at high speeds over all kinds of topographical features.

METAGROSS,1.Pokedex: Its intellect surpasses its previous level, resulting in battles so cruel, they'll make you want to cover your eyes.

CHERRIM,1.Pokedex: After absorbing plenty of sunlight, Cherrim takes this form. It's full of energy while it's like this, and its liveliness will go on until sundown.

SHELLOS,1.Pokedex: Its appearance changes depending on the environment. One theory suggests that living in cold seas causes Shellos to take on this form.

GASTRODON,1.Pokedex: Its body is covered in a sticky slime. It's very susceptible to dehydration, so it can't spend too much time on land.

LOPUNNY,1.Pokedex: It swings its ears like whips and strikes its enemies with them. It has an intensely combative disposition.

GARCHOMP,1.Pokedex: Its vaunted wings become scythes, sending it mad with rage. It swings its scythes wildly and slices the ground to pieces.

LUCARIO,1.Pokedex: It readies itself to face its enemies by focusing its mental energies. Its fighting style can be summed up in a single word: heartless.

ROTOM,1.Pokedex: This Rotom has possessed a convection microwave oven that uses a special motor. It also has a flair for manipulating flames.

ROTOM,2.Pokedex: This form of Rotom enjoys coming up with water-based pranks. Be careful with it if you don't want your room flooded.

ROTOM,3.Pokedex: Rotom assumes this form when it takes over a refrigerator powered by a special motor. It battles by spewing cold air.

ROTOM,4.Pokedex: In this form, Rotom applies its new power over wind to its love of pranks. It will happily blow away any important documents it can find.

ROTOM,5.Pokedex: This is Rotom after it's seized control of a lawn mower that has a special motor. As it mows down grass, it scatters the clippings everywhere.

BASCULIN,1.Pokedex: Even Basculin, which devours everything it can with its huge jaws, is nothing more than food to organisms stronger than itself.

DARUMAKA,2.Pokedex: The colder they get, the more energetic they are. They freeze their breath to make snowballs, using them as ammo for playful snowball fights.

DARMANITAN,1.Pokedex: When wounded, it stops moving. It goes as still as stone to meditate, sharpening its mind and spirit.

DARMANITAN,2.Pokedex: On days when blizzards blow through, it comes down to where people live. It stashes food in the snowball on its head, taking it home for later.

DARMANITAN,3.Pokedex: Anger has reignited its atrophied flame sac. This Pokémon spews fire everywhere as it rampages indiscriminately.

YAMASK,1.Pokedex: A clay slab with cursed engravings took possession of a Yamask. The slab is said to be absorbing the Yamask's dark power.

STUNFISK,1.Pokedex: Its conspicuous lips lure prey in as it lies in wait in the mud. When prey gets close, Stunfisk clamps its jagged steel fins down on them.

KYUREM,1.Pokedex: It has foreseen that a world of truth will arrive for people and Pokémon. It strives to protect that future.

KYUREM,2.Pokedex: It's said that this Pokémon battles in order to protect the ideal world that will exist in the future for people and Pokémon.

KELDEO,1.Pokedex: The power that lay hidden in its body now covers its horn, turning it into a sword that can slice through anything.

FLOETTE,5.Pokedex: The flower it's holding can no longer be found blooming anywhere. It's also thought to contain terrifying power.

MEOWSTIC,1.Pokedex: Females are a bit more selfish and aggressive than males. If they don't get what they want, they will torment you with their psychic abilities.

AEGISLASH,1.Pokedex: Once upon a time, a king with an Aegislash reigned over the land. His Pokémon eventually drained him of life, and his kingdom fell with him.

PUMPKABOO,1.Pokedex: Spirits that wander this world are placed into Pumpkaboo's body. They're then moved on to the afterlife.

PUMPKABOO,2.Pokedex: When taking spirits to the afterlife, large Pumpkaboo prefer the spirits of adults to those of children.

PUMPKABOO,3.Pokedex: Massive Pumpkaboo are said to be the product of areas where a great number of lost souls lingered.

GOURGEIST,1.Pokedex: Eerie cries emanate from its body in the dead of night. The sounds are said to be the wails of spirits who are suffering in the afterlife.

GOURGEIST,2.Pokedex: Large Gourgeist put on the guise of adults, taking the hands of children to lead them to the afterlife.

GOURGEIST,3.Pokedex: Supersized Gourgeist aren't picky. They will forcefully drag anyone off to the afterlife.

ZYGARDE,1.Pokedex: This is Zygarde when about 10% of its pieces have been assembled. It leaps at its opponent's chest and sinks its sharp fangs into them.

ZYGARDE,2.Pokedex: This is Zygarde's perfected form. From the orifice on its chest, it radiates high-powered energy that eliminates everything.

ORICORIO,1.Pokedex: It creates an electric charge by rubbing its feathers together. It dances over to its enemies and delivers shocking electrical punches.

ORICORIO,2.Pokedex: This Oricorio relaxes by swaying gently. This increases its psychic energy, which it then fires at its enemies.

ORICORIO,3.Pokedex: It summons the dead with its dreamy dancing. From their malice, it draws power with which to curse its enemies.

LYCANROC,1.Pokedex: It goads its enemies into attacking, withstands the hits, and in return, delivers a headbutt, crushing their bones with its rocky mane.

LYCANROC,2.Pokedex: Bathed in the setting sun of evening, Lycanroc has undergone a special kind of evolution. An intense fighting spirit underlies its calmness.

WISHIWASHI,1.Pokedex: Weak Wishiwashi school together to concentrate their power. Their united force makes them the demon of the sea, feared near and far.

MINIOR,7.Pokedex: If its core stays exposed, it will soon die off. It's possible that it may survive if it's put into a Poké Ball quickly enough.

MINIOR,8.Pokedex: If its core stays exposed, it will soon die off. It's possible that it may survive if it's put into a Poké Ball quickly enough.

MINIOR,9.Pokedex: If its core stays exposed, it will soon die off. It's possible that it may survive if it's put into a Poké Ball quickly enough.

MINIOR,10.Pokedex: If its core stays exposed, it will soon die off. It's possible that it may survive if it's put into a Poké Ball quickly enough.

MINIOR,11.Pokedex: If its core stays exposed, it will soon die off. It's possible that it may survive if it's put into a Poké Ball quickly enough.

MINIOR,12.Pokedex: If its core stays exposed, it will soon die off. It's possible that it may survive if it's put into a Poké Ball quickly enough.

MINIOR,13.Pokedex: If its core stays exposed, it will soon die off. It's possible that it may survive if it's put into a Poké Ball quickly enough.

MIMIKYU,1.Pokedex: Sad that its true identity may be exposed, Mimikyu will mercilessly seek revenge on any opponent that breaks its neck.

NECROZMA,1.Pokedex: This is Necrozma's form while it's absorbing the power of Solgaleo, making it extremely ferocious and impossible to control.

NECROZMA,2.Pokedex: Lunala no longer has a will of its own. Now under the control of Necrozma, it continuously expels all of its energy.

NECROZMA,3.Pokedex: The light pouring out from all over its body affects living things and nature, impacting them in various ways.

MAGEARNA,1.Pokedex: This gorgeous Magearna looks as it did at the time of its invention. Its luxurious decoration pleased the king's daughter.

CRAMORANT,1.Pokedex: Cramorant's gluttony led it to try to swallow an Arrokuda whole, which in turn led to Cramorant getting an Arrokuda stuck in its throat.

CRAMORANT,2.Pokedex: This Cramorant has accidentally gotten a Pikachu lodged in its gullet. Cramorant is choking a little, but it isn't really bothered.

TOXTRICITY,1.Pokedex: Capable of generating 15,000 volts of electricity, this Pokémon looks down on all that would challenge it.

SINISTEA,1.Pokedex: The swirl pattern in this Pokémon's body is its weakness. If it gets stirred, the swirl loses its shape, and Sinistea gets dizzy.

POLTEAGEIST,1.Pokedex: Trainers Polteageist trusts will be allowed to experience its distinctive flavor and aroma firsthand by sampling just a tiny bit of its tea.

ALCREMIE,7.Pokedex: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream a sweet and tart flavor.

ALCREMIE,14.Pokedex: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream an aromatic flavor.

ALCREMIE,21.Pokedex: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream a refreshing flavor.

ALCREMIE,28.Pokedex: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream a sour flavor.

ALCREMIE,35.Pokedex: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream a salty flavor.

ALCREMIE,42.Pokedex: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream a mixed flavor.

ALCREMIE,49.Pokedex: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream a bitter flavor.

ALCREMIE,56.Pokedex: The cells that compose its cream fluctuated suddenly during evolution, giving the cream a complex flavor.

EISCUE,1.Pokedex: The ice covering this Pokémon's face has shattered, revealing a slightly worried expression that many people are enamored with.

INDEEDEE,1.Pokedex: They diligently serve people and Pokémon so they can gather feelings of gratitude. The females are particularly good at babysitting.

MORPEKO,1.Pokedex: Hunger hormones affect its temperament. Until its hunger is appeased, it gets up to all manner of evil deeds.

ZACIAN,1.Pokedex: Able to cut down anything with a single strike, it became known as the Fairy King's Sword, and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.

ZAMAZENTA,1.Pokedex: Its ability to deflect any attack led to it being known as the Fighting Master's Shield. It was feared and respected by all.

URSHIFU,1.Pokedex: It's believed that this Pokémon modeled its fighting style on the flow of a river—sometimes rapid, sometimes calm.

CALYREX,1.Pokedex: According to lore, this Pokémon showed no mercy to those who got in its way, yet it would heal its opponents' wounds after battle.

CALYREX,2.Pokedex: Legend says that by using its power to see all events from past to future, this Pokémon saved the creatures of a forest from a meteorite strike.

WYRDEER.Name: Wyrdeer
WYRDEER.Pokedex: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing

KLEAVOR.Name: Kleavor
KLEAVOR.Pokedex: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

URSALUNA.Name: Ursaluna
URSALUNA.Pokedex: It is believed that the swampy terrain of its ancient home region that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

BASCULEGION.Name: Basculegion
BASCULEGION.Pokedex: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout other aquatic environments is Basculegion’s equal.

SNEASLER.Name: Sneasler
SNEASLER.Pokedex: Because of Sneasler’s virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.

OVERQWIL.Name: Overqwil
OVERQWIL.Pokedex: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname "sea fiend." It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

ENAMORUS.Name: Enamorus
ENAMORUS.Pokedex: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

SPRIGATITO.Name: Sprigatito
SPRIGATITO.Pokedex: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

FLORAGATO.Name: Floragato
FLORAGATO.Pokedex: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

MEOWSCARADA.Name: Meowscarada
MEOWSCARADA.Pokedex: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

FUECOCO.Name: Fuecoco
FUECOCO.Pokedex: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

CROCALOR.Name: Crocalor
CROCALOR.Pokedex: The combination of Crocalor’s fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon’s head.

SKELEDIRGE.Name: Skeledirge
SKELEDIRGE.Pokedex: The fiery bird changes shape when Skeledirge sings. Rumor has it that the bird was born when the fireball on Skeledirge’s head gained a soul.

QUAXLY.Name: Quaxly
QUAXLY.Pokedex: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.

QUAXWELL.Name: Quaxwell
QUAXWELL.Pokedex: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.

QUAQUAVAL.Name: Quaquaval
QUAQUAVAL.Pokedex: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.

LECHONK.Name: Lechonk
LECHONK.Pokedex: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn’t use it for anything other than foraging.

OINKOLOGNE.Name: Oinkologne
OINKOLOGNE.Pokedex: It entrances female Pokémon with the sweet, alluring scent that wafts from all over its body.

TAROUNTULA.Name: Tarountula
TAROUNTULA.Pokedex: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon’s natural enemy.

SPIDOPS.Name: Spidops
SPIDOPS.Pokedex: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.

NYMBLE.Name: Nymble
NYMBLE.Pokedex: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it’s in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

LOKIX.Name: Lokix
LOKIX.Pokedex: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.

PAWMI.Name: Pawmi
PAWMI.Pokedex: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

PAWMO.Name: Pawmo
PAWMO.Pokedex: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

PAWMOT.Name: Pawmot
PAWMOT.Pokedex: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

TANDEMAUS.Name: Tandemaus
TANDEMAUS.Pokedex: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

MAUSHOLD.Name: Maushold
MAUSHOLD.Pokedex: They build huge nests with many rooms that are used for different purposes, such as eating and sleeping.

FIDOUGH.Name: Fidough
FIDOUGH.Pokedex: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough’s breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon’s vicinity.

DACHSBUN.Name: Dachsbun
DACHSBUN.Pokedex: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon’s body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

SMOLIV.Name: Smoliv
SMOLIV.Pokedex: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

DOLLIV.Name: Dolliv
DOLLIV.Pokedex: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

ARBOLIVA.Name: Arboliva
ARBOLIVA.Pokedex: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

SQUAWKABILLY.Name: Squawkabilly
SQUAWKABILLY.Pokedex: These Pokémon prefer to live in cities. They form flocks based on the color of their feathers, and they fight over territory.

NACLI.Name: Nacli
NACLI.Pokedex: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

NACLSTACK.Name: Naclstack
NACLSTACK.Pokedex: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey’s body.

GARGANACL.Name: Garganacl
GARGANACL.Pokedex: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

CHARCADET.Name: Charcadet
CHARCADET.Pokedex: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

ARMAROUGE.Name: Armarouge
ARMAROUGE.Pokedex: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

CERULEDGE.Name: Ceruledge
CERULEDGE.Pokedex: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

TADBULB.Name: Tadbulb
TADBULB.Pokedex: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

BELLIBOLT.Name: Bellibolt
BELLIBOLT.Pokedex: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

WATTREL.Name: Wattrel
WATTREL.Pokedex: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

KILOWATTREL.Name: Kilowattrel
KILOWATTREL.Pokedex: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

MASCHIFF.Name: Maschiff
MASCHIFF.Pokedex: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff’s face.

MABOSSTIFF.Name: Mabosstiff
MABOSSTIFF.Pokedex: This Pokémon can store energy in its large dewlap. Mabosstiff unleashes this energy all at once to blow away enemies.

SHROODLE.Name: Shroodle
SHROODLE.Pokedex: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

GRAFAIAI.Name: Grafaiai
GRAFAIAI.Pokedex: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.

BRAMBLIN.Name: Bramblin
BRAMBLIN.Pokedex: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

BRAMBLEGHAST.Name: Brambleghast
BRAMBLEGHAST.Pokedex: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.

TOEDSCOOL.Name: Toedscool
TOEDSCOOL.Pokedex: Toedscool lives in muggy forests. The flaps that fall from its body are chewy and very delicious.

TOEDSCRUEL.Name: Toedscruel
TOEDSCRUEL.Pokedex: These Pokémon gather into groups and form colonies deep within forests. They absolutely hate it when strangers approach.

KLAWF.Name: Klawf
KLAWF.Pokedex: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can’t remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.

CAPSAKID.Name: Capsakid
CAPSAKID.Pokedex: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

SCOVILLAIN.Name: Scovillain
SCOVILLAIN.Pokedex: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.

RELLOR.Name: Rellor
RELLOR.Pokedex: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.

RABSCA.Name: Rabsca
RABSCA.Pokedex: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

FLITTLE.Name: Flittle
FLITTLE.Pokedex: Flittle’s toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon’s belly.

ESPATHRA.Name: Espathra
ESPATHRA.Pokedex: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.

TINKATINK.Name: Tinkatink
TINKATINK.Pokedex: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

TINKATUFF.Name: Tinkatuff
TINKATUFF.Pokedex: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

TINKATON.Name: Tinkaton
TINKATON.Pokedex: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

WIGLETT.Name: Wiglett
WIGLETT.Pokedex: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

WUGTRIO.Name: Wugtrio
WUGTRIO.Pokedex: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

BOMBIRDIER.Name: Bombirdier
BOMBIRDIER.Pokedex: It gathers things up in an apron made from shed feathers added to the Pokémon’s chest feathers, then drops those things from high places for fun.

FINIZEN.Name: Finizen
FINIZEN.Pokedex: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

PALAFIN.Name: Palafin
PALAFIN.Pokedex: This Pokémon changes its appearance if it hears its allies calling for help. Palafin will never show anybody its moment of transformation.

VAROOM.Name: Varoom
VAROOM.Pokedex: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

REVAVROOM.Name: Revavroom
REVAVROOM.Pokedex: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders— now numbering eight—to generate energy.

CYCLIZAR.Name: Cyclizar
CYCLIZAR.Pokedex: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

ORTHWORM.Name: Orthworm
ORTHWORM.Pokedex: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.

GLIMMET.Name: Glimmet
GLIMMET.Pokedex: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.

GLIMMORA.Name: Glimmora
GLIMMORA.Pokedex: When this Pokémon detects danger, it will open up its crystalline petals and fire beams from its conical body.

GREAVARD.Name: Greavard
GREAVARD.Pokedex: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.

HOUNDSTONE.Name: Houndstone
HOUNDSTONE.Pokedex: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.

FLAMIGO.Name: Flamigo
FLAMIGO.Pokedex: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

CETODDLE.Name: Cetoddle
CETODDLE.Pokedex: This species left the ocean and began living on land a very long time ago. It seems to be closely related to Wailmer.

CETITAN.Name: Cetitan
CETITAN.Pokedex: This Pokémon wanders around snowy, icy areas. It protects its body with powerful muscles and a thick layer of fat under its skin.

VELUZA.Name: Veluza
VELUZA.Pokedex: When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind becomes honed and its psychic power increases. The spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor.

DONDOZO.Name: Dondozo
DONDOZO.Pokedex: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it’s bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.

TATSUGIRI.Name: Tatsugiri
TATSUGIRI.Pokedex: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

ANNIHILAPE.Name: Annihilape
ANNIHILAPE.Pokedex: When its anger rose beyond a critical point, this Pokémon gained power that is unfettered by the limits of its physical body.

CLODSIRE.Name: Clodsire
CLODSIRE.Pokedex: When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate by sticking thick spines out from its body. It’s a risky move that puts everything on the line.

FARIGIRAF.Name: Farigiraf
FARIGIRAF.Pokedex: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig’s.

DUDUNSPARCE.Name: Dudunsparce
DUDUNSPARCE.Pokedex: This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.

KINGAMBIT.Name: Kingambit
KINGAMBIT.Pokedex: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.

GREATTUSK.Name: Great Tusk
GREATTUSK.Pokedex: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. The name Great Tusk was taken from a creature listed in a certain book.

SCREAMTAIL.Name: Scream Tail
SCREAMTAIL.Pokedex: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.

BRUTEBONNET.Name: Brute Bonnet
BRUTEBONNET.Pokedex: It is possible that the creature listed as Brute Bonnet in a certain book could actually be this Pokémon.

FLUTTERMANE.Name: Flutter Mane
FLUTTERMANE.Pokedex: This Pokémon has characteristics similar to those of Flutter Mane, a creature mentioned in a certain book.

SLITHERWING.Name: Slither Wing
SLITHERWING.Pokedex: This mysterious Pokémon has some similarities to a creature that an old book introduced as Slither Wing.

SANDYSHOCKS.Name: Sandy Shocks
SANDYSHOCKS.Pokedex: No records exist of this Pokémon being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with a creature shown in an expedition journal.

IRONTREADS.Name: Iron Treads
IRONTREADS.Pokedex: This Pokémon closely resembles a scientific weapon that a paranormal magazine claimed was sent to this planet by aliens.

IRONBUNDLE.Name: Iron Bundle
IRONBUNDLE.Pokedex: Its shape is similar to a robot featured in a paranormal magazine article. The robot was said to have been created by an ancient civilization.

IRONHANDS.Name: Iron Hands
IRONHANDS.Pokedex: It is very similar to a cyborg covered exclusively by a paranormal magazine. The cyborg was said to be the modified form of a certain athlete.

IRONJUGULIS.Name: Iron Jugulis
IRONJUGULIS.Pokedex: It resembles a certain Pokémon introduced in a paranormal magazine, described as the offspring of a Hydreigon that fell in love with a robot.

IRONMOTH.Name: Iron Moth
IRONMOTH.Pokedex: This Pokémon resembles an unknown object described in a paranormal magazine as a UFO sent to observe humanity.

IRONTHORNS.Name: Iron Thorns
IRONTHORNS.Pokedex: It has some similarities to a Pokémon introduced in a dubious magazine as a Tyranitar from one billion years into the future.

FRIGIBAX.Name: Frigibax
FRIGIBAX.Pokedex: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

ARCTIBAX.Name: Arctibax
ARCTIBAX.Pokedex: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

BAXCALIBUR.Name: Baxcalibur
BAXCALIBUR.Pokedex: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.

GIMMIGHOUL.Name: Gimmighoul
GIMMIGHOUL.Pokedex: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.

GHOLDENGO.Name: Gholdengo
GHOLDENGO.Pokedex: Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 coins. This Pokémon gets along well with others and is quick to make friends with anybody.

WOCHIEN.Name: Wo-Chien
WOCHIEN.Pokedex: The grudge of a person punished for writing the king’s evil deeds upon wooden tablets has clad itself in dead leaves to become a Pokémon.

CHIENPAO.Name: Chien-Pao
CHIENPAO.Pokedex: This Pokémon can control 100 tons of fallen snow. It plays around innocently by leaping in and out of avalanches it has caused.

TINGLU.Name: Ting-Lu
TINGLU.Pokedex: The fear poured into an ancient ritual vessel has clad itself in rocks and dirt to become a Pokémon.

CHIYU.Name: Chi-Yu
CHIYU.Pokedex: It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit. It casually swims through the sea of lava it creates by melting rock and sand.

ROARINGMOON.Name: Roaring Moon
ROARINGMOON.Pokedex: It is possible that this is the creature listed as Roaring Moon in an expedition journal that still holds many mysteries.

IRONVALIANT.Name: Iron Valiant
IRONVALIANT.Pokedex: It has some similarities to a mad scientist’s invention covered in a paranormal magazine.

KORAIDON.Name: Koraidon
KORAIDON.Pokedex: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.

MIRAIDON.Name: Miraidon
MIRAIDON.Pokedex: Much remains unknown about this creature. It resembles Cyclizar, but it is far more ruthless and powerful.

WALKINGWAKE.Name: Walking Wake
WALKINGWAKE.Pokedex: This ferocious creature is shrouded in mystery. It's named after an aquatic monster mentioned in an old expedition journal.

IRONLEAVES.Name: Iron Leaves
IRONLEAVES.Pokedex: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.

DIPPLIN.Name: Dipplin
DIPPLIN.Pokedex: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.

POLTCHAGEIST.Name: Poltchageist
POLTCHAGEIST.Pokedex: Supposedly, the regrets of a tea ceremony master who died before perfecting his craft lingered in some matcha and became a Pokémon.

SINISTCHA.Name: Sinistcha
SINISTCHA.Pokedex: It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into drinking it so it can drain their life-force. Its ruse is generally unsuccessful.

OKIDOGI.Name: Okidogi
OKIDOGI.Pokedex: After all its muscles were stimulated by the toxic chain around its neck, Okidogi transformed and gained a powerful physique.

MUNKIDORI.Name: Munkidori
MUNKIDORI.Pokedex: The chain is made from toxins that enhance capabilities. It stimulated Munkidori's brain and caused the Pokémon's psychic powers to bloom.

FEZANDIPITI.Name: Fezandipiti
FEZANDIPITI.Pokedex: Fezandipiti owes its beautiful looks and lovely voice to the toxic stimulants emanating from the chain wrapped around its body.

OGERPON.Name: Ogerpon
OGERPON.Pokedex: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.

ARCHALUDON.Name: Archaludon
ARCHALUDON.Pokedex: It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It’s so durable that being caught in a cave-in won’t faze it.

HYDRAPPLE.Name: Hydrapple
HYDRAPPLE.Pokedex: Seven syrpents live inside an apple made of syrup. The syrpent in the center is the commander.

GOUGINGFIRE.Name: Gouging Fire
GOUGINGFIRE.Pokedex: There are scant few reports of this creature being sighted. One short video shows it rampaging and spouting pillars of flame.

RAGINGBOLT.Name: Raging Bolt
RAGINGBOLT.Pokedex: It's said to incinerate everything around it with lightning launched from its fur. Very little is known about this creature.

IRONBOULDER.Name: Iron Boulder
IRONBOULDER.Pokedex: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.

IRONCROWN.Name: Iron Crown
IRONCROWN.Pokedex: There was supposedly an incident in which it launched shining blades to cut everything around it to pieces. Little else is known about it.

TERAPAGOS.Name: Terapagos
TERAPAGOS.Pokedex: Terapagos protects itself using its power to transform energy into hard crystals. This Pokémon is the source of the Terastal phenomenon.

PECHARUNT.Name: Pecharunt
PECHARUNT.Pokedex: It feeds others toxic mochi that draw out desires and capabilities. Those who eat the mochi fall under Pecharunt's control, chained to its will.

GROWLITHE,1.Pokedex: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

ARCANINE,1.Pokedex: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

VOLTORB,1.Pokedex: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.

ELECTRODE,1.Pokedex: The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.

TAUROS,1.Pokedex: This kind of Tauros, known as the Combat Breed, is distinguished by its thick, powerful muscles and its fierce disposition.

TAUROS,2.Pokedex: People call this kind of Tauros the Blaze Breed due to the hot air it snorts from its nostrils. Its three tails are intertwined.

TAUROS,3.Pokedex: It swims by jetting water from its horns. The most notable characteristic of the Aqua Breed is its high body fat, which allows it to float easily.

TYPHLOSION,1.Pokedex: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.

WOOPER,1.Pokedex: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

QWILFISH,1.Pokedex: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.

SNEASEL,1.Pokedex: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.

DIALGA,1.Pokedex: Radiant light caused Dialga to take on a form bearing a striking resemblance to the creator Pokémon. Dialga now wields such colossal strength that one must conclude this is its true form.

PALKIA,1.Pokedex: It soars across the sky in a form that greatly resembles the creator of all things. Perhaps this imitation of appearance is Palkia's strategy for gaining Arceus's powers.

SAMUROTT,1.Pokedex: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

LILLIGANT,1.Pokedex: They suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

BASCULIN,2.Pokedex: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—people have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

ZORUA,1.Pokedex: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

ZOROARK,1.Pokedex: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.

BRAVIARY,1.Pokedex: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.

SLIGGOO,1.Pokedex: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.

GOODRA,1.Pokedex: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

AVALUGG,1.Pokedex: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.

DECIDUEYE,1.Pokedex: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.

ENAMORUS,1.Pokedex: A different guise from its feminine humanoid form. From the clouds, it descends upon those who treat any form of life with disrespect and metes out wrathful, ruthless punishment.

OINKOLOGNE,1.Pokedex: This is a meticulous Pokémon that likes to keep things tidy. It shrouds itself in a floral aroma that soothes the Pokémon around it.

TATSUGIRI,1.Pokedex: This species’ differing colors and patterns are apparently the result of Tatsugiri changing itself to suit the preferences of the prey it lures in.

TATSUGIRI,2.Pokedex: Bird Pokémon are its main prey. This Pokémon knows it’s weak, so it hunts with a partner.

SQUAWKABILLY,1.Pokedex: Blue-feathered Squawkabilly view their green- feathered counterparts as rivals, since the latter make up the largest, most powerful groups.

SQUAWKABILLY,2.Pokedex: The yellow Squawkabilly are especially fierce. They've even been known to drive other bird Pokémon out of town.

SQUAWKABILLY,3.Pokedex: Though these Squawkabilly are the fewest in number, they have no trouble living in towns since they blend in with the white buildings.

GIMMIGHOUL,1.Pokedex: This Pokémon was born from passion that seeped into a coin. It wanders, apparently seeking to return to the treasure chest it once inhabited.

POLTCHAGEIST,1.Pokedex: It sprinkles some of its powdery body onto food and drains the life-force from those who so much as lick it.

SINISTCHA,1.Pokedex: It lives inside a superb teacup that was crafted by a potter of great renown. Collectors positively adore this Pokémon.

OGERPON,1.Pokedex: This form excels in both attack and defense. It ceaselessly unleashes moves like a spring gushes water.

OGERPON,2.Pokedex: This form is the most aggressive, bombarding enemies with the intensity of flames blazing within a hearth.

OGERPON,3.Pokedex: This form has excellent defenses, absorbing impacts solidly like the cornerstones that support houses.

TERAPAGOS,1.Pokedex: The shell is made of crystallized Terastal energy. When struck by a move, this shell absorbs the move’s energy and transfers it to Terapagos.

TERAPAGOS,2.Pokedex: In this form, Terapagos resembles the world as the ancients saw it, and its Terastal energy is abnormally amplified.

CLEFABLE,1.Pokedex: It flies by using the power of moonlight to control gravity within a radius of over 32 feet around it.

VICTREEBEL,1.Pokedex: The volume of this Pokémon's acid has increased and filling its mouth. If it's not careful, it will overflow and spill out.

STARMIE,1.Pokedex: Its movements have become more humanlike. Whether it's simply trying to communicate or wants to supplant humanity is unclear.

DRAGONITE,1.Pokedex: Mega Evolution has excessively powered up this Pokémon's feelings of kindness. It finishes off its opponents with mercy in its heart.

MEGANIUM,1.Pokedex: This Pokémon can fire a tremendously powerful Solar Beam from its four flowers. Another name for this is Mega Sol Cannon.

FERALIGATR,1.Pokedex: With its arms and hoodlike fin, this Pokémon forms a gigantic set of jaws with a bite 10 times as powerful as Mega Feraligatr's actual jaws.

SKARMORY,1.Pokedex: It flies faster than the speed of sound. After whipping up shock waves to send enemies flying, it finishes them off with its talons.

FROSLASS,1.Pokedex: This Pokémon can use eerie cold air imbued with ghost energy to freeze even insubstantial things, such as flames or the wind.

EMBOAR,1.Pokedex: Brandishing a blazing flame shaped like a serpentine spear, it rushes in to rescue its imperiled allies.

EXCADRILL,1.Pokedex: If this Pokémon brings its arms and head together to form a streamlined shape and spins at high speeds, it can destroy anything.

SCOLIPEDE,1.Pokedex: Its deadly venom gives off a faint glow. The venom affects Scolipede's mind, honing its viciousness.

SCRAFTY,1.Pokedex: Mega Evolution has caused Scrafty's shed skin to turn white, growing tough and supple. Of course, this Pokémon is still as feisty as ever.

EELEKTROSS,1.Pokedex: It now generates 10 times the electricity it did before Mega Evolving. It discharges this electricity from its false Eelektrik, which are made of mucus.

CHANDELURE,1.Pokedex: One of its eyes is a window linking our world with the afterlife. This Pokémon draws in hatred and converts it into power.

CHESNAUGHT,1.Pokedex: It has fortified armor and a will to defend at all costs. Both are absurdly strong.

DELPHOX,1.Pokedex: It wields flaming branches to dazzle its opponents before incinerating them with a huge fireball.

GRENINJA,3.Pokedex: This Pokémon spins a giant shuriken at high speed to make it float, then clings to it upside down to catch opponents unawares.

PYROAR,1.Pokedex: This Pokémon spews flames hotter than 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit. It swings around its grand, blazing mane as it protects its allies.

FLOETTE,6.Pokedex: The Eternal Flower has absorbed all the energy from Mega Evolution. The flower now attacks enemies on its own.

MALAMAR,1.Pokedex: It uses its colorful lights to overwrite the personalities and memories of others—and to control them.

BARBARACLE,1.Pokedex: It uses its many arms to toy with its opponents. This keeps the head extremely busy.

DRAGALGE,1.Pokedex: It spits a liquid that causes the regenerative power of cells to run wild. The liquid is deadly poison to everything other than itself.

HAWLUCHA,1.Pokedex: Mega Evolution has pumped up all its muscles. Hawlucha flexes to show off its strength.

ZYGARDE,4.Pokedex: In response to people's emotions during an unprecedented crisis, Zygarde Mega Evolves and calms the situation with its unmatched power.

DRAMPA,1.Pokedex: Drampa's cells have been invigorated, allowing it to regain its youth. It manipulates the atmosphere to summon storms.

FALINKS,1.Pokedex: Mega Falinks has taken on the ultimate battle formation, which can be achieved only if the troopers and brass have the strongest of bonds.

RAICHU,2.Pokedex: It resembles an X as it flies through the air with 50 million volts of electricity sparking from its ears and forked tail.

RAICHU,3.Pokedex: It fires bolts of electricity from the tip of its tail and from the spiky tufts of fur growing out of its temples. This electricity forms the letter Y.

CHIMECHO,1.Pokedex: It vibrates its entire body to attack in all directions using sound waves. Any who hear the vibrations get so confused, they forget who they are.

ABSOL,2.Pokedex: Using fur that it has made into sharp, clawlike shapes, it cuts down foes with a single blow. This is an act of kindness to keep them from suffering.

STARAPTOR,1.Pokedex: Mega Staraptor is a top-class flier. It can easily soar through the sky while gripping a Steelix that weighs more than 880 lbs.

GARCHOMP,2.Pokedex: Garchomp has gained a new Mega-Evolved form. It flies around foes at Mach speed and cuts them to shreds with its sinister wing claws.

LUCARIO,2.Pokedex: By completely cloaking itself in its aura, Mega Lucario Z can parry all manner of attacks, battling as if it were gracefully dancing.

HEATRAN,1.Pokedex: It's said that if it goes all out, it can heat its body up to temperatures over 1.8 million degrees Fahrenheit. This heat keeps enemies at bay.

DARKRAI,1.Pokedex: Its dark power blocks out the sun, plunging the surrounding area into darkness. There is no escaping its evil eye.

GOLURK,1.Pokedex: The energy within Golurk has been stimulated by Mega Evolution. The Pokémon could explode at any moment.

MEOWSTIC,2.Pokedex: Mega Meowstic can use its psychic power to compress or expand anything. It overwhelms foes by contorting space itself.

MEOWSTIC,3.Pokedex: Mega Meowstic can use its psychic power to compress or expand anything. It overwhelms foes by contorting space itself.

CRABOMINABLE,1.Pokedex: It can pulverize reinforced concrete with a light swing of one of its fists, each of which is covered in a thick layer of ice.

GOLISOPOD,1.Pokedex: It uses four of its arms to fiercely assail its foes. Once they've been pushed to the brink of defeat, it finishes them off with the arms it kept hidden.

MAGEARNA,2.Pokedex: This is Magearna once a previously hidden mode activates. The emotions Magearna had begun to feel now hide away as it fells foe after foe.

MAGEARNA,3.Pokedex: A mechanism to remove Magerna's limitations has lain secretly with Magerna for 500 years. This mechanism is triggered by a Mega Stone.

ZERAORA,1.Pokedex: It stores up 10 lightning strikes' worth of electricity. When it stops limiting itself, it's in the strongest class of electric Pokémon.

SCOVILLAIN,1.Pokedex: Mega Evolution has dialed up this Pokémon's spiciness. It swings its "necktie" around to wallop its foes.

GLIMMORA,1.Pokedex: Glimmora's petals-now larger and separated from its main body-rotate around it to provide defense while scattering poisonous fragments.

TATSUGIRI,3.Pokedex: Tatsugiri's brain has been invigorated by Mega Evolution, making it even wilier. It can create and command copies of itself.

TATSUGIRI,4.Pokedex: It solidifies the energy of Mega Evolution, building up an overflowing pile to launch as projectiles. These projectiles explode on contact.

TATSUGIRI,5.Pokedex: Using the energy of Mega Evolution, it creates a dish to ride upon, allowing it to move with total freedom-even through the air.

BAXCALIBUR,1.Pokedex: Baxcalibur's dorsal blade has grown even more massive thanks to Mega Evolution. This Pokémon fires beams from the hilt at its solar plexus.

MEGAHORN.Name: Megahorn
MEGAHORN.Description: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.

ATTACKORDER.Name: Attack Order
ATTACKORDER.Description: The user calls out its underlings to pummel the target. Critical hits land more easily.

BUGBUZZ.Name: Bug Buzz
BUGBUZZ.Description: The user vibrates its wings to generate a sound wave. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

FIRSTIMPRESSION.Name: First Impression
FIRSTIMPRESSION.Description: Although this move has great power, it only works the first turn the user is in battle.

POLLENPUFF.Name: Pollen Puff
POLLENPUFF.Description: Fires an exploding pollen puff at enemies, or a HP-restoring one at allies.

LEECHLIFE.Name: Leech Life
LEECHLIFE.Description: The user drains the target's blood. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

LUNGE.Name: Lunge
LUNGE.Description: The user makes a lunge at the target, attacking with full force. This lowers the target's Attack stat.

XSCISSOR.Name: X-Scissor
XSCISSOR.Description: The user slashes at the foe by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

SIGNALBEAM.Name: Signal Beam
SIGNALBEAM.Description: The user attacks with a sinister beam of light. It may also confuse the target.

SKITTERSMACK.Name: Skitter Smack
SKITTERSMACK.Description: The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

UTURN.Name: U-turn
UTURN.Description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

STEAMROLLER.Name: Steamroller
STEAMROLLER.Description: The user crushes its foes by rolling over them. This attack may make the target flinch.

BUGBITE.Name: Bug Bite
BUGBITE.Description: The user bites the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

SILVERWIND.Name: Silver Wind
SILVERWIND.Description: The foe is attacked with powdery scales blown by wind. It may also raise all the user's stats.

FELLSTINGER.Name: Fell Stinger
FELLSTINGER.Description: When the user knocks out a target with this move, the user's Attack stat rises drastically.

STRUGGLEBUG.Name: Struggle Bug
STRUGGLEBUG.Description: While resisting, the user attacks the opposing Pokémon. The targets' Sp. Atk stat is reduced.

FURYCUTTER.Name: Fury Cutter
FURYCUTTER.Description: The target is slashed with scythes or claws. Its power increases if it hits in succession.

PINMISSILE.Name: Pin Missile
PINMISSILE.Description: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.

TWINEEDLE.Name: Twineedle
TWINEEDLE.Description: The foe is stabbed twice by a pair of stingers. It may also poison the target.

INFESTATION.Name: Infestation
INFESTATION.Description: The target is infested and unable to flee for four to five turns.

DEFENDORDER.Name: Defend Order
DEFENDORDER.Description: The user calls out its underlings to shield its body, raising its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

HEALORDER.Name: Heal Order
HEALORDER.Description: The user calls out its underlings to heal it. The user regains up to half of its max HP.

POWDER.Name: Powder
POWDER.Description: The target is covered in a powder that explodes and damages it if it uses a Fire-type move.

QUIVERDANCE.Name: Quiver Dance
QUIVERDANCE.Description: The user performs a beautiful dance. It boosts the user's Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.

RAGEPOWDER.Name: Rage Powder
RAGEPOWDER.Description: The user scatters irritating powder to draw attention to itself. Opponents aim only at the user.

SPIDERWEB.Name: Spider Web
SPIDERWEB.Description: The user ensnares the target with thin, gooey silk so it can't flee from battle.

STICKYWEB.Name: Sticky Web
STICKYWEB.Description: Weaves a sticky net around the opposing team, which lowers their Speed stats upon switching in.

STRINGSHOT.Name: String Shot
STRINGSHOT.Description: The foe is bound with silk blown from the user's mouth. This silk reduces the target's Speed.

TAILGLOW.Name: Tail Glow
TAILGLOW.Description: The user stares at flashing lights to focus its mind, drastically raising its Sp. Atk stat.

HYPERSPACEFURY.Name: Hyperspace Fury
HYPERSPACEFURY.Description: Unleashes a barrage of multi-arm attacks, skipping protections. The user's Defense stat falls.

FOULPLAY.Name: Foul Play
FOULPLAY.Description: The user turns the foe's power against it. It does more damage the higher the target's Attack stat.

FIERYWRATH.Name: Fiery Wrath
FIERYWRATH.Description: The user transforms its wrath into a fire-like aura to attack. This may also make foes flinch.

DARKESTLARIAT.Name: Darkest Lariat
DARKESTLARIAT.Description: The user swings both arms and hits the target. Ignores the target's stat changes.

NIGHTDAZE.Name: Night Daze
NIGHTDAZE.Description: The user lets loose a pitch-black shock wave at its target. It may also lower the target's accuracy.

CRUNCH.Name: Crunch
CRUNCH.Description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. It may also lower the target's Defense stat.

DARKPULSE.Name: Dark Pulse
DARKPULSE.Description: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. It may also make the target flinch.

FALSESURRENDER.Name: False Surrender
FALSESURRENDER.Description: The user pretends to bow its head, but then it stabs the target with its disheveled hair. Never misses.

JAWLOCK.Name: Jaw Lock
JAWLOCK.Description: This move prevents the user and the target from switching out until either of them faints.

THROATCHOP.Name: Throat Chop
THROATCHOP.Description: The user attacks the target's throat. The target cannot use sound-based moves for two turns.

WICKEDBLOW.Name: Wicked Blow
WICKEDBLOW.Description: Strikes with a fierce blow through mastery of the Dark style. Always results in a critical hit.

LASHOUT.Name: Lash Out
LASHOUT.Description: The user lashes out to vent its frustration. Power is doubled if its stats dropped this turn.

NIGHTSLASH.Name: Night Slash
NIGHTSLASH.Description: The user slashes the target the instant an opportunity arises. Critical hits land more easily.

SUCKERPUNCH.Name: Sucker Punch
SUCKERPUNCH.Description: This move enables the user to attack first. It fails if the target is not readying an attack, however.

KNOCKOFF.Name: Knock Off
KNOCKOFF.Description: The user slaps down the target's held item, preventing that item from being used in the battle.

ASSURANCE.Name: Assurance
ASSURANCE.Description: If the target has already taken some damage in the same turn, this attack's power is doubled.

BITE.Name: Bite
BITE.Description: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. It may make the target flinch.

BRUTALSWING.Name: Brutal Swing
BRUTALSWING.Description: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.

FEINTATTACK.Name: Feint Attack
FEINTATTACK.Description: The user draws up to the foe disarmingly, then throws a sucker punch. It hits without fail.

THIEF.Name: Thief
THIEF.Description: The user attacks and steals the foe's held item simultaneously. It can't steal if the user holds an item.

SNARL.Name: Snarl
SNARL.Description: The user yells as if it is ranting about something, making the target's Sp. Atk stat decrease.

PAYBACK.Name: Payback
PAYBACK.Description: If the user moves after the target, this attack's power will be doubled.

PURSUIT.Name: Pursuit
PURSUIT.Description: An attack move that inflicts double damage if used on a target that is switching out of battle.

BEATUP.Name: Beat Up
BEATUP.Description: The user gets all the party Pokémon to attack the foe. The more party Pokémon, the more damage.

FLING.Name: Fling
FLING.Description: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.

POWERTRIP.Name: Power Trip
POWERTRIP.Description: The user boasts of its strength. Power increases the more the user's stats are raised.

PUNISHMENT.Name: Punishment
PUNISHMENT.Description: This attack's power increases the more the target has powered up with stat changes.

DARKVOID.Name: Dark Void
DARKVOID.Description: Opposing Pokémon are dragged into a world of total darkness that makes them sleep.

EMBARGO.Name: Embargo
EMBARGO.Description: It prevents the target from using its held item. Its Trainer is also prevented from using items on it.

FAKETEARS.Name: Fake Tears
FAKETEARS.Description: The user feigns crying to fluster the target, harshly lowering its Sp. Def stat.

FLATTER.Name: Flatter
FLATTER.Description: Flattery is used to confuse the target. However, it also raises the target's Sp. Atk stat.

HONECLAWS.Name: Hone Claws
HONECLAWS.Description: The user sharpens its claws to boost its Attack stat and accuracy.

MEMENTO.Name: Memento
MEMENTO.Description: The user faints when using this move. In return, it harshly lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk.

NASTYPLOT.Name: Nasty Plot
NASTYPLOT.Description: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. It sharply raises the user's Sp. Atk.

OBSTRUCT.Name: Obstruct
OBSTRUCT.Description: The user protects itself from all attacks. Direct contact lowers the attacker's Defense.

PARTINGSHOT.Name: Parting Shot
PARTINGSHOT.Description: With a parting threat, the user lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats. Then it switches out.

QUASH.Name: Quash
QUASH.Description: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.

SNATCH.Name: Snatch
SNATCH.Description: The user steals the effects of any healing or stat-changing move the foe attempts to use.

SWITCHEROO.Name: Switcheroo
SWITCHEROO.Description: The user trades held items with the target faster than the eye can follow.

TAUNT.Name: Taunt
TAUNT.Description: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

TOPSYTURVY.Name: Topsy-Turvy
TOPSYTURVY.Description: All stat changes affecting the target turn topsy-turvy and become the opposite of what they were.

TORMENT.Name: Torment
TORMENT.Description: The user torments and enrages the foe, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

ETERNABEAM.Name: Eternabeam
ETERNABEAM.Description: This is Eternatus's most powerful attack in its original form. The user can't move on the next turn.

DRAGONENERGY.Name: Dragon Energy
DRAGONENERGY.Description: Converts life-force into power to attack. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.

ROAROFTIME.Name: Roar of Time
ROAROFTIME.Description: The user blasts the target with power that distorts even time. The user must rest on the next turn.

DRACOMETEOR.Name: Draco Meteor
DRACOMETEOR.Description: Comets are summoned down from the sky. The attack's recoil harshly reduces the user's Sp. Atk stat.

OUTRAGE.Name: Outrage
OUTRAGE.Description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. It then becomes confused, however.

CLANGINGSCALES.Name: Clanging Scales
CLANGINGSCALES.Description: The user rubs its scales and makes a huge noise. Also lowers the user's Defense stat.

COREENFORCER.Name: Core Enforcer
COREENFORCER.Description: If the target has already moved this turn, the effect of its Ability is negated.

DRAGONRUSH.Name: Dragon Rush
DRAGONRUSH.Description: The user tackles the foe while exhibiting overwhelming menace. It may also make the target flinch.

DYNAMAXCANNON.Name: Dynamax Cannon
DYNAMAXCANNON.Description: The user unleashes a strong beam from its core.

SPACIALREND.Name: Spacial Rend
SPACIALREND.Description: The user tears the target along with the space around it. Critical hits land more easily.

DRAGONHAMMER.Name: Dragon Hammer
DRAGONHAMMER.Description: The user uses its body like a hammer to attack the target and inflict damage.

DRAGONPULSE.Name: Dragon Pulse
DRAGONPULSE.Description: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user's gaping mouth.

DRAGONCLAW.Name: Dragon Claw
DRAGONCLAW.Description: The user slashes the target with huge, sharp claws.

BREAKINGSWIPE.Name: Breaking Swipe
BREAKINGSWIPE.Description: The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks all foes. This also lowers their Attack stats.

DRAGONBREATH.Name: Dragon Breath
DRAGONBREATH.Description: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

DRAGONTAIL.Name: Dragon Tail
DRAGONTAIL.Description: The user knocks away the target and drags out another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

DRAGONDARTS.Name: Dragon Darts
DRAGONDARTS.Description: The user attacks twice using Dreepy. If there are two targets, this move hits each one once.

DUALCHOP.Name: Dual Chop
DUALCHOP.Description: The user attacks its target by hitting it with brutal strikes. The target is hit twice in a row.

TWISTER.Name: Twister
TWISTER.Description: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at the opposing team. It may also make targets flinch.

SCALESHOT.Name: Scale Shot
SCALESHOT.Description: Attacks by shooting scales two to five times in a row. Boosts the user's Speed but lowers its Defense.

DRAGONRAGE.Name: Dragon Rage
DRAGONRAGE.Description: This attack hits the target with a shock wave of pure rage. This attack always inflicts 40 HP damage.

CLANGOROUSSOUL.Name: Clangorous Soul
CLANGOROUSSOUL.Description: The user raises all its stats by using some of its HP.

DRAGONDANCE.Name: Dragon Dance
DRAGONDANCE.Description: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that boosts its Attack and Speed stats.

BOLTSTRIKE.Name: Bolt Strike
BOLTSTRIKE.Description: The user charges at its foe, surrounding itself with lightning. It may also leave the target paralyzed.

VOLTTACKLE.Name: Volt Tackle
VOLTTACKLE.Description: The user electrifies itself, then charges at the foe. It causes considerable damage to the user as well.

ZAPCANNON.Name: Zap Cannon
ZAPCANNON.Description: The user fires an electric blast like a cannon to inflict damage and cause paralysis.

AURAWHEEL.Name: Aura Wheel
AURAWHEEL.Description: Morpeko attacks and raises its Speed with energy stored in its cheeks. Type changes with the user's form.

THUNDER.Name: Thunder
THUNDER.Description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the foe to inflict damage. It may also leave the target paralyzed.

FUSIONBOLT.Name: Fusion Bolt
FUSIONBOLT.Description: The user throws down a giant thunderbolt. It does more damage if influenced by an enormous flame.

PLASMAFISTS.Name: Plasma Fists
PLASMAFISTS.Description: The user attacks with electrically charged fists. Normal-type moves become Electric-type.

THUNDERBOLT.Name: Thunderbolt
THUNDERBOLT.Description: A strong electric blast is loosed at the target. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

WILDCHARGE.Name: Wild Charge
WILDCHARGE.Description: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its foe. It also damages the user a little.

BOLTBEAK.Name: Bolt Beak
BOLTBEAK.Description: Stabs the target with an electrified beak. Power is doubled if the user attacks first.

DISCHARGE.Name: Discharge
DISCHARGE.Description: A flare of electricity is loosed to strike the area around the user. It may also cause paralysis.

OVERDRIVE.Name: Overdrive
OVERDRIVE.Description: The user attacks all foes by twanging a guitar or bass guitar, causing a huge echo and strong vibration.

THUNDERCAGE.Name: Thunder Cage
THUNDERCAGE.Description: The user traps the target in a cage of sparking electricity for four to five turns.

ZINGZAP.Name: Zing Zap
ZINGZAP.Description: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target. This may also make the target flinch.

THUNDERPUNCH.Name: Thunder Punch
THUNDERPUNCH.Description: The target is punched with an electrified fist. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

RISINGVOLTAGE.Name: Rising Voltage
RISINGVOLTAGE.Description: The user attacks with electric voltage rising from the ground. Power is doubled on Electric Terrain.

VOLTSWITCH.Name: Volt Switch
VOLTSWITCH.Description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

PARABOLICCHARGE.Name: Parabolic Charge
PARABOLICCHARGE.Description: The user attacks everything around it. The user's HP is restored by half the damage dealt.

SPARK.Name: Spark
SPARK.Description: The user throws an electrically charged tackle at the target. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

THUNDERFANG.Name: Thunder Fang
THUNDERFANG.Description: The user bites with electrified fangs. It may also make the target flinch or leave it with paralysis.

SHOCKWAVE.Name: Shock Wave
SHOCKWAVE.Description: The user strikes the target with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack cannot be evaded.

ELECTROWEB.Name: Electroweb
ELECTROWEB.Description: The user captures and attacks foes by using an electric net, which lowers their Speed stat.

CHARGEBEAM.Name: Charge Beam
CHARGEBEAM.Description: The user fires a concentrated bundle of electricity. It may also raise the user's Sp. Atk stat.

THUNDERSHOCK.Name: Thunder Shock
THUNDERSHOCK.Description: A jolt of electricity is hurled at the foe to inflict damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

NUZZLE.Name: Nuzzle
NUZZLE.Description: The user nuzzles its electrified cheeks against the target. This also leaves the target with paralysis.

ELECTROBALL.Name: Electro Ball
ELECTROBALL.Description: The user hurls an electric orb at the foe. It does more damage the faster the user is.

CHARGE.Name: Charge
CHARGE.Description: The user boosts the power of the Electric move it uses next. It also raises the user's Sp. Def stat.

EERIEIMPULSE.Name: Eerie Impulse
EERIEIMPULSE.Description: The user's body generates an eerie impulse. Harshly lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

ELECTRICTERRAIN.Name: Electric Terrain
ELECTRICTERRAIN.Description: The user electrifies the ground for five turns. Pokémon on the ground no longer fall asleep.

ELECTRIFY.Name: Electrify
ELECTRIFY.Description: If the target uses a move after being electrified, that move becomes Electric-type.

IONDELUGE.Name: Ion Deluge
IONDELUGE.Description: The user disperses electrically charged particles. Normal-type moves become Electric-type.

MAGNETRISE.Name: Magnet Rise
MAGNETRISE.Description: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.

MAGNETICFLUX.Name: Magnetic Flux
MAGNETICFLUX.Description: Manipulates magnetic fields to raise the Defense and Sp. Def stats of allies with Plus or Minus Abilities.

THUNDERWAVE.Name: Thunder Wave
THUNDERWAVE.Description: A weak electric charge is launched at the target. It causes paralysis if it hits.

LIGHTOFRUIN.Name: Light of Ruin
LIGHTOFRUIN.Description: Fires a powerful beam of light drawn from the Eternal Flower. It also damages the user a lot.

FLEURCANNON.Name: Fleur Cannon
FLEURCANNON.Description: The user unleashes a strong beam. The attack's recoil harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.

MISTYEXPLOSION.Name: Misty Explosion
MISTYEXPLOSION.Description: The user attacks everything around and faints upon using this move. Power increases on Misty Terrain.

MOONBLAST.Name: Moonblast
MOONBLAST.Description: The user attacks by borrowing the power of the moon. This may also lower the target's Sp. Atk stat.

PLAYROUGH.Name: Play Rough
PLAYROUGH.Description: The user plays rough with the target and attacks it. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.

STRANGESTEAM.Name: Strange Steam
STRANGESTEAM.Description: The user attacks the target by emitting steam. This may also confuse the target.

DAZZLINGGLEAM.Name: Dazzling Gleam
DAZZLINGGLEAM.Description: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

SPIRITBREAK.Name: Spirit Break
SPIRITBREAK.Description: The user attacks the target with immense force. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

DRAININGKISS.Name: Draining Kiss
DRAININGKISS.Description: The user steals the target's HP with a kiss. The user's HP is restored by over half of the damage dealt.

DISARMINGVOICE.Name: Disarming Voice
DISARMINGVOICE.Description: Letting out a charming cry, the user does emotional damage to foes. This attack never misses.

FAIRYWIND.Name: Fairy Wind
FAIRYWIND.Description: The user stirs up a fairy wind and strikes the target with it.

NATURESMADNESS.Name: Nature's Madness
NATURESMADNESS.Description: The user hits the target with the force of nature. It halves the target's HP.

AROMATICMIST.Name: Aromatic Mist
AROMATICMIST.Description: The user raises the Sp. Def stat of an ally Pokémon by using a mysterious aroma.

BABYDOLLEYES.Name: Baby-Doll Eyes
BABYDOLLEYES.Description: The user stares with its baby-doll eyes, which lowers the target's Attack stat. Always goes first.

CHARM.Name: Charm
CHARM.Description: The user charmingly gazes at the foe, making it less wary. The target's Attack is harshly lowered.

CRAFTYSHIELD.Name: Crafty Shield
CRAFTYSHIELD.Description: The user protects itself and its allies from status moves with a mysterious power.

DECORATE.Name: Decorate
DECORATE.Description: The user sharply raises the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats by decorating the target.

FAIRYLOCK.Name: Fairy Lock
FAIRYLOCK.Description: By locking down the battlefield, the user keeps all Pokémon from fleeing during the next turn.

FLORALHEALING.Name: Floral Healing
FLORALHEALING.Description: The user restores the target's HP by up to half of its max HP. It restores more HP when the terrain is grass.

FLOWERSHIELD.Name: Flower Shield
FLOWERSHIELD.Description: The user raises the Defense stats of all Grass-type Pokémon in battle with a mysterious power.

GEOMANCY.Name: Geomancy
GEOMANCY.Description: The user absorbs energy and sharply raises its Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats on the next turn.

MISTYTERRAIN.Name: Misty Terrain
MISTYTERRAIN.Description: The user covers the ground with mist for five turns. Grounded Pokémon can't gain status conditions.

MOONLIGHT.Name: Moonlight
MOONLIGHT.Description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

SWEETKISS.Name: Sweet Kiss
SWEETKISS.Description: The user kisses the target with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.

FOCUSPUNCH.Name: Focus Punch
FOCUSPUNCH.Description: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. It will fail if the user is hit before it is used.

METEORASSAULT.Name: Meteor Assault
METEORASSAULT.Description: The user attacks wildly with its thick leek. The user can't move on the next turn.

HIGHJUMPKICK.Name: High Jump Kick
HIGHJUMPKICK.Description: The target is attacked with a knee kick from a jump. If it misses, the user is hurt instead.

CLOSECOMBAT.Name: Close Combat
CLOSECOMBAT.Description: The user fights the foe up close without guarding itself. It also cuts the user's Defense and Sp. Def.

FOCUSBLAST.Name: Focus Blast
FOCUSBLAST.Description: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def.

SUPERPOWER.Name: Superpower
SUPERPOWER.Description: The user attacks the target with great power. However, it also lowers the user's Attack and Defense.

CROSSCHOP.Name: Cross Chop
CROSSCHOP.Description: The user delivers a double chop with its forearms crossed. Critical hits land more easily.

DYNAMICPUNCH.Name: Dynamic Punch
DYNAMICPUNCH.Description: The user punches the target with full, concentrated power. It confuses the target if it hits.

FLYINGPRESS.Name: Flying Press
FLYINGPRESS.Description: The user dives down onto the target from the sky. This move is Fighting and Flying type simultaneously.

HAMMERARM.Name: Hammer Arm
HAMMERARM.Description: The user swings and hits with its strong and heavy fist. It lowers the user's Speed, however.

JUMPKICK.Name: Jump Kick
JUMPKICK.Description: The user jumps up high, then strikes with a kick. If the kick misses, the user hurts itself.

SACREDSWORD.Name: Sacred Sword
SACREDSWORD.Description: The user attacks by slicing with its long horns. The target's stat changes don't affect the damage.

THUNDEROUSKICK.Name: Thunderous Kick
THUNDEROUSKICK.Description: Overwhelms the target with lightning-like movement, then kicks. Lowers the target's Defense stat.

SECRETSWORD.Name: Secret Sword
SECRETSWORD.Description: The user cuts with its long horn. The odd power contained in it does physical damage to the foe.

SKYUPPERCUT.Name: Sky Uppercut
SKYUPPERCUT.Description: The user attacks the target with an uppercut thrown skyward with force.

AURASPHERE.Name: Aura Sphere
AURASPHERE.Description: The user looses a blast of aura power from deep within its body. This move is certain to hit.

BODYPRESS.Name: Body Press
BODYPRESS.Description: The user slams its body into the target. Deals more damage with a higher Defense stat.

SUBMISSION.Name: Submission
SUBMISSION.Description: The user grabs the target and recklessly dives for the ground. It also hurts the user slightly.

BRICKBREAK.Name: Brick Break
BRICKBREAK.Description: The user attacks with a swift chop. It can also break any barrier such as Light Screen and Reflect.

DRAINPUNCH.Name: Drain Punch
DRAINPUNCH.Description: An energy-draining punch. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

VITALTHROW.Name: Vital Throw
VITALTHROW.Description: The user attacks last. In return, this throw move is guaranteed not to miss.

WAKEUPSLAP.Name: Wake-Up Slap
WAKEUPSLAP.Description: This attack inflicts big damage on a sleeping target. It also wakes the target up, however.

LOWSWEEP.Name: Low Sweep
LOWSWEEP.Description: The user attacks the target's legs swiftly, reducing the target's Speed stat.

CIRCLETHROW.Name: Circle Throw
CIRCLETHROW.Description: The user throws the target and drags out another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

FORCEPALM.Name: Force Palm
FORCEPALM.Description: The target is attacked with a shock wave. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

REVENGE.Name: Revenge
REVENGE.Description: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the foe in the same turn.

ROLLINGKICK.Name: Rolling Kick
ROLLINGKICK.Description: The user lashes out with a quick, spinning kick. It may also make the target flinch.

STORMTHROW.Name: Storm Throw
STORMTHROW.Description: The user strikes the target with a fierce blow. This attack always results in a critical hit.

KARATECHOP.Name: Karate Chop
KARATECHOP.Description: The target is attacked with a sharp chop. Critical hits land more easily.

MACHPUNCH.Name: Mach Punch
MACHPUNCH.Description: The user throws a punch at blinding speed. It is certain to strike first.

POWERUPPUNCH.Name: Power-Up Punch
POWERUPPUNCH.Description: Striking opponents repeatedly makes the user's fists harder, raising the user's Attack stat.

ROCKSMASH.Name: Rock Smash
ROCKSMASH.Description: The user attacks with a punch that can shatter a rock. It may also lower the foe's Defense stat.

VACUUMWAVE.Name: Vacuum Wave
VACUUMWAVE.Description: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the target. This move always goes first.

DOUBLEKICK.Name: Double Kick
DOUBLEKICK.Description: The target is quickly kicked twice in succession using both feet.

ARMTHRUST.Name: Arm Thrust
ARMTHRUST.Description: The user looses a flurry of open-palmed arm thrusts that hit two to five times in a row.

TRIPLEKICK.Name: Triple Kick
TRIPLEKICK.Description: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successive hit.

COUNTER.Name: Counter
COUNTER.Description: A retaliation move that counters any physical attack, inflicting double the damage taken.

FINALGAMBIT.Name: Final Gambit
FINALGAMBIT.Description: The user risks all to attack the foe. The user faints but does damage equal to its HP.

LOWKICK.Name: Low Kick
LOWKICK.Description: A powerful low kick that makes the foe fall over. It inflicts greater damage on heavier foes.

REVERSAL.Name: Reversal
REVERSAL.Description: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

SEISMICTOSS.Name: Seismic Toss
SEISMICTOSS.Description: The target is thrown using the power of gravity. It inflicts damage equal to the user's level.

BULKUP.Name: Bulk Up
BULKUP.Description: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting both its Attack and Defense stats.

COACHING.Name: Coaching
COACHING.Description: The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon, boosting their Attack and Defense stats.

DETECT.Name: Detect
DETECT.Description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

MATBLOCK.Name: Mat Block
MATBLOCK.Description: Using a pulled-up mat as a shield, the user protects itself and its allies from damaging moves.

NORETREAT.Name: No Retreat
NORETREAT.Description: This move raises all the user's stats but prevents the user from switching out or fleeing.

OCTOLOCK.Name: Octolock
OCTOLOCK.Description: Locks the target in and prevents it from fleeing. Also lowers the target's Defense and Sp. Def each turn.

QUICKGUARD.Name: Quick Guard
QUICKGUARD.Description: The user protects itself and its allies from priority moves. If may fail if used in succession.

VCREATE.Name: V-create
VCREATE.Description: With a fiery forehead, the user hurls itself at the foe. It lowers the user's Defense, Sp. Def, and Speed.

BLASTBURN.Name: Blast Burn
BLASTBURN.Description: The target is razed by a fiery explosion. The user must rest on the next turn, however.

ERUPTION.Name: Eruption
ERUPTION.Description: The user attacks in an explosive fury. The lower the user's HP, the less powerful this attack becomes.

MINDBLOWN.Name: Mind Blown
MINDBLOWN.Description: The user attacks everything by causing its own head to explode. This also damages the user.

SHELLTRAP.Name: Shell Trap
SHELLTRAP.Description: The user sets a shell trap. If it is hit by a physical move, the trap explodes and hurt the attacker.

BLUEFLARE.Name: Blue Flare
BLUEFLARE.Description: The user attacks by engulfing the foe in a beautiful, yet intense, blue flame. It may also burn the foe.

BURNUP.Name: Burn Up
BURNUP.Description: To inflict massive damage, the user burns itself out. The user will no longer be Fire type.

OVERHEAT.Name: Overheat
OVERHEAT.Description: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack's recoil sharply reduces the user's Sp. Atk stat.

FLAREBLITZ.Name: Flare Blitz
FLAREBLITZ.Description: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the foe. The user takes damage and may burn the target.

PYROBALL.Name: Pyro Ball
PYROBALL.Description: Attacks by igniting a small stone and launching it as a fiery ball. May also burn the target.

FIREBLAST.Name: Fire Blast
FIREBLAST.Description: The foe is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.

FUSIONFLARE.Name: Fusion Flare
FUSIONFLARE.Description: The user brings down a giant flame. It does more damage if influenced by an enormous thunderbolt.

INFERNO.Name: Inferno
INFERNO.Description: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense fire. It leaves the target with a burn.

MAGMASTORM.Name: Magma Storm
MAGMASTORM.Description: The target becomes trapped within a maelstrom of fire that rages for four to five turns.

SACREDFIRE.Name: Sacred Fire
